info.name: Get the user's PII using a ScopeRequestId provided by Civic

params.name: scopeRequestId
params.description: The ID that was provided to you by Civic after the user has submitted their PII

items.docs: After the user's PII has been delivered to Civic, we give you an ID (scopeRequestId) that can be used to retrieve the user's PII before issuing the Civic Pass.

info.name: Approve or Reject receipt of PII, to allow or block issuance of the user's Civic Pass.

params.name: scopeRequestId
params.description: The ID that was provided to you by Civic after the user has submitted their PII

items.docs: After you reviewed the user's PII returned by the GET /piirequest/{scopeRequestId} endpoint, you can approve or reject the user's Civic Pass by calling this endpoint.
